author: M1sericordia
quote: honestly, i'm starting to question what the hell they're doing with gta 6. jason has got to be one of the weakest male protagonists i've seen in a GTA game. where's the masculine energy? where's the dominance? where's the feeling that you're actually playing a guy who can take charge? it feels like lucia is leading everything while jason is just there following her around. the entire game seems to revolve around lucia, and jason feels more like a side character in his own **** don't even get me started on the relationship mechanics. you can't even enjoy one of the most iconic GTA activities anymore because apparently you're in a committed relationship. seriously? this is GTA. we're supposed to have freedom to do whatever the hell we want, including hiring hoes. if they wanted to make a game centered around romance, relationships, and domestic life, they should've just created an entirely new IP instead of turning GTA into something it was never meant to **** from what we've seen, it feels like the game is all about following instructions and doing chores. painting drywalls, building lifetime tables, buying groceries for your virtual girlfriend, and whatever other domestic activities they decided to throw in. apparently you're expected to do all of these things just to complete the game. where's the freedom? where's the chaos? where's the actual GTA experience?it honestly feels like a feminist take on what GTA should be, rather than what players have traditionally loved about GTA. jason doesn't feel like an independent character who can make his own decisions. it feels like you're being dragged through lucia's life, doing whatever you're told, and not having much room to be your own character.i don't want a virtual domestic life simulator. i want GTA. i want the freedom to explore, cause chaos, make money, build an empire, hire prostitutes, get into trouble, and do whatever the hell i want without the game constantly pushing me into some relationship **** i wanted to spend my free time painting walls, building furniture, and buying groceries for my virtual girlfriend, i'd just go outside and do actual chores.what we want is freedom, not a virtual prison with a mission checklist. let jason be his own man and let players experience the full ridiculous freedom that made GTA what it is.
